LifeGive Body Caps & Flakes 

LifeGive Body is freeze-dried Aphanizomenom flos-aquae which is the earth’s first living food, harvested wild from Upper Klamath Lake, Oregon U.S.A. A special proprietary process assures you the highest standard of purity. By adding LifeGive Body to your diet you’ll receive the most balanced, complete, nutrient-rich food on earth, providing the highest protein and trace mineral concentration of any natural food. LifeGive Body is the freeze-dried powered form of LifeGive Live, which may be used while traveling when refrigeration is not possible. Many chose to use LifeGive Body for convenience.

The nutrients in LifeGive Body may:

  1. Increase energy, vitality and endurance

  2. Strengthen the immune system, which fights disease

  3. Improve attention and alertness

  4. Support brain function and ability to manage stress

    5. *Enzyme Active * Easy to digest * Naturally Chelated Minerals*

    Directions: Keep in cool, dry place. Start with ½ teaspoon (1-2 caps) per day and increase to 1 teaspoon (4 days), or as needed, based on your individual needs. Take before or with a meal, early in the day. mix with water or juice. Important: Drink plenty of pure water.

    These statements have not been evaluated by the food and drug administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease.
